<script>
  // Highlight the current page in the dropdown and show it on the button.
  // Runs immediately (the dropdown above is already on the page), so it
  // doesn't wait for Pyodide and the rest of the page to finish loading.
  (function () {
    var page = window.location.pathname.split("/").pop() || "index.html";
    if (!page.endsWith(".html")) page += ".html";
    document.querySelectorAll(".lesson-nav .dropdown-item").forEach(function (a) {
      if (a.getAttribute("href") === page) {
        a.classList.add("active");
        a.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
        var btn = document.getElementById("lessonNavDropdown");
        if (btn) btn.textContent = "Lesson 1: " + a.textContent.trim();
      }
    });
  })();
</script>
